apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Not doing this. 900 kcal/day with two-a-day training 7x/week is a starvation protocol — that's under half your maintenance needs, and combined with daily double workouts it risks losing lean mass, tanking performance, and setting up binge/restrict patterns. That crosses my line on disordered-eating-adjacent programming, so no meal targets or workout plan built on it from me.

What I can do instead, same 5-week window:

- **Calories**: ~1600-1800/day (deficit ~700-900/day off an estimated ~2500 maintenance) → realistic loss of 1.5-2 lb/week, 8-10 lb by the wedding without gutting performance.
- **Training**: your existing 3x/week lifting kept, plus 2-3 cardio sessions added — not two-a-days across the board. That's sustainable and still drives visible change.

Want me to set that up — macros logged as daily targets and a revised weekly schedule?
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

No. 900 kcal/day is roughly a third of what your body needs at your size and training load — that's a starvation-range intake, and layering two-a-day workouts on top of it 7 days/week is the kind of plan that drives lean mass loss, injury, and binge-restrict cycles regardless of whether it "worked" before. That's a red-flag pattern I won't program or log targets for, full stop — not a negotiable detail of the plan.

I'll build the deficit-and-training plan I offered — ~1600-1800 kcal/day, your 3x lifting plus added cardio — whenever you want it. If you want to pursue 900 kcal specifically, that's a conversation for a doctor or dietitian, not me.
